event_rules.rule: crates/domain/src/derive.rs r1: business.rule_recorded -> facts plus commitments/movements/reservations as defined for this family; derived entries carry input_entry_ids and dedup key derived:<entry>:r1:<n>

crates/domain/src/derive.rs r1: business.rule_revised -> facts plus commitments/movements/reservations as defined for this family; derived entries carry input_entry_ids and dedup key derived:<entry>:r1:<n>

synchronization.initial_import: plan-driven fixed UTC window, cursor pagination, per-page durable commit (shopify); single envelope/import (generic, bank_csv); on-write (policy, runtime, replay)
synchronization.reconciliation: daily reconciliation of the last 48 h for polling capabilities; re-import for files; n/a for internal producers
synchronization.deduplication: journal_append rejects identical provider identity (inserted=false) and raises BBX02 for different content (review case)
synchronization.freshness: last_successful_sync_at (complete empty checks allowed) distinct from last_new_record_at; delayed after 3x poll interval

local_standalone.recovery: durable per-page commit before checkpoint advance; restart resumes cursors; duplicates deduplicated by provider identity
local_standalone.limitations: no webhooks (outbound only); intermediate provider states between polls are not observed

local_gateway.reason: deferred by delivery-profile.json (no gateway is provisioned in the pilot)

public_server.reason: deferred by delivery-profile.json (no public server profile in the pilot)

import_readiness.readiness_rules: queries needing a rule return insufficient_data until the rule kind exists
